description: Collection-only Knowledge effects and the cooked-tier outcome for the retained owner save. Native arithmetic comes from Idleon 1.24; no cooking action or random draw is executed.
target: SushiStation collection XP factor, cooked-tier outcome, Knowledge upgrade-cost factor, faster-Fuel factor, and collection Perfecto factor

extractions.label: sushi_effects_knowledge_experience_percent
extractions.description: Collection Knowledge XP bonus in percent. Convert to 1 + percent / 100 for the collection factor only, not the full slot XP multiplier. Source: idleon1.24.txt:244728-244733.

extractions.label: sushi_effects_cooked_tier_percent
extractions.description: Combined cooking upgrade 7 and Knowledge category 2 bonus. Native cooking adds floor(percent / 100 + a uniform random value in [0, 1)). Therefore floor(percent / 100) tiers are guaranteed; the fractional remainder is the chance for one more tier. Do not cap the combined input at 100%. Sources: idleon1.24.txt:244667,295763-295766.

extractions.label: sushi_effects_knowledge_upgrade_cost_factor
extractions.description: The reciprocal Knowledge factor applied to upgrade costs, not the raw percentage or a final upgrade price. Source: idleon1.24.txt:244599-244611.

extractions.label: sushi_effects_faster_fuel_knowledge_factor
extractions.description: The three separate Knowledge factors multiplied by native Fuel generation. Only King Beef Sashimi, Abalone Sashimi, and Imaginei Dragonroll contribute here. Leviathan Roll at index 57 is not part of this native product. Source: idleon1.24.txt:244632-244649.

extractions.label: sushi_effects_knowledge_perfecto_percent
extractions.description: Collection Perfecto bonus in percent. Convert to 1 + percent / 100 for the collection chance factor, not a tier-specific probability. Source: idleon1.24.txt:244755.
